newsitem.title: UK: Tascorp raises 6.5 bln yen with four bonds.
newsitem.headline: Tascorp raises 6.5 bln yen with four bonds.

text.p: Tasmanian Public Finance Corp (Tascorp) has issued four bonds for a total of 6.5 billion yen, lead manager Nikko Europe said.
The deals are all reverse dual currency bonds.
A 3.0 billion yen 10-year bond pays a 3.22 percent sterling coupon and was issued at 100.325.
A 2.0 billion yen 10-year bond pays an a 3.20 percent Australian dollar coupon and was issued at 100.425.
There was also a 1.0 billion yen 10-year bond which paid an Australian dollar coupon, and a 500 million yen seven-year deal which paid in sterling. Both bonds were structured.
